trace_report.likely_fatal_step: Picked first: step 5 (manufactured deployment-matched instances) together with its supporting claim 'Then i relates to F^(-m) exactly as an outer test composition relates to F^full, up to the training set being one inner fold smaller' and the BLOCK-2 assertion that the naive's out-of-fold tuning has M identically 0. Reason: every guarantee the candidate states (lambda* estimable, non-negative in-fold effect, switch-off where A is noisy) is inherited from this fold-relation equivalence; if any model inside A_i saw y_i, or if the instance geometry differs from deployment, the damping is fit on the wrong object. Result of the attack: the expert-level fold relation is leak-free as written (no blocking defect), but (a) the fixed level-1 weights beta saw both excluded folds, so 'exactly' is conditional; (b) at small J the pair-excluded refits are trained on n(1-2/J) points against n(1-1/J) for the deployment-side analogue models (n/3 vs 2n/3 at J=3), which made the manufactured analogue pessimistic and drove lambda to 0 on the J=3 instance (parameter note); (c) the BLOCK-2 claim 'M is identically 0' in the naive's OOF tuning is false for every cross-fold neighbour (mean |M_i| = 0.199, max 0.640 executed).

Quoted: 'for each expert in the candidate set E, train on T_k minus P_m ... fit non-negative level-1 weights beta ... refit all experts on T_k to form F^full.' beta is fit once on the OOF predictions of ALL of T_k and reused in F^(-m), F^full and F^(-m,-m'); step 7 says E is selected 'before steps 3-6' though it is listed after step 6 (ordering wording). Instantiated: J=3 and J=6; E = {inverse-distance 2-NN on element fractions (admissible kNN expert, interpolating), ridge on fractions}; beta=[0.7349, 0.2743] at J=3; tau = raw target.

Verified in execution that A_i only ever evaluates F^(-m,-m(j)) at x_i in P_m and x_j in P_m(j), so the storage claim is consistent. Training size of each pair refit: n(1-2/J) = 20 at J=3, 40 at J=6.
Instantiated with rho = Euclidean on fractions (stand-in for standardised Magpie Euclidean).

The kernel shape K is not specified; Gaussian K used. sigma_A is ambiguous ('per-neighbour transfer terms': transfer F(x_q)-F(x_j) only, or per-neighbour estimate y_j + transfer); both readings computed.

formalized_procedure.note: Quoted: 'fit lambda on instances from all but one inner fold m by minimising the realised loss ... score on the held-out m; select the configuration with the lowest grouped-CV loss, with the lambda = 0 configuration always in the candidate set; refit the selected lambda on all instances.' Instantiated Lambda = {0} union {sigmoid(a + b log delta_1): a in {-6,-3,-1,0,1,3,6}, b in {-2..2}} (my own illustrative logistic member); h in {0.02, 0.05, 0.1}, k_nn in {3, 5}; absolute-error loss.

Quoted: 'Select the expert set E by the same grouped inner CV on the stack's out-of-fold loss before steps 3-6'. Textual position after S6 contradicts its stated execution order; formalized as running between S2 and S3. In the trace E was fixed per arm (main: kNN+ridge; positive control: ridge only).
Executed identity: naive F^full(x_q) + sum_j w_qj r_j equals A_q + M_q to 4.4e-16 (forced by algebra: sum_j w_qj = 1).

Not instantiated numerically (regression instance); rule is closed-form (inverse link or clipping). On the logit scale a base probability of exactly 0 or 1 gives an infinite logit residual (degenerate probe).

negative_control.evidence: Named negative control A2b (reinject M_q: naive transfer F^(-m)(x_i) + lambda(s_i) sum_j w_ij [y_j - F^(-m,-m(j))(x_j)] on the instances, deployed as F^full + lambda(s_q) sum w r_j). Outcome = outer MAE in the near-duplicate stratum. J=6, E={kNN, ridge}: A2 0.3624 -> A2b 0.3729 (= A0/A1 level 0.3729; A2b's fitted lambda collapsed to 0, as predicted). J=3 ridge-only: A2 0.3063 -> A2b 0.3268. J=6 ridge-only: 0.3597 -> 0.3682. On the J=3 kNN+ridge instance the control is a no-op (A2 and A2b both selected lambda=0, both equal A0 = 0.3692) because the J=3 pair-excluded analogue was too weak for any lambda>0 to be selected (see parameter note). Label-permutation control, executed under two readings: P1 (permute y within each inner fold only when building the instances; stack trained on true y): selected lambda is NOT 0 (config h=0.1, k_nn=5, (a,b)=(-3,-1); grouped-CV loss 45.32 < lambda=0 loss 51.07) and outer MAE moves 0.3988 -> 0.3792 rather than returning to A0; at J=6 likewise 0.4031 -> 0.3711. P2 (permute before training the stack too): lambda=0 selected, outer prediction = A0. Under P1 the blend of two predictors whose errors on the permuted target are both large and imperfectly correlated reduces loss by averaging, so lambda>0 is the expected outcome (see the switch-off anomaly), not a failure of the control's execution.

dry_run.instance: n=60 training compositions on the 3-element simplex: 12 cluster centres (Dirichlet(1,1,1)), 5 members each with N(0,0.01) jitter; y = 3 x1 - 2 x2^2 + cluster offset N(0,0.5) + N(0,0.3) (within-neighbourhood co-variation, premise P1, by construction). Outer test: 30 queries (10 near-duplicates of training points, jitter 0.003; 10 intermediate, jitter 0.06 around centres; 10 off-support random). J in {3, 6} random inner folds. Experts: inverse-distance 2-NN on element fractions (admissible kNN expert, a deterministic rule) and ridge on fractions; NNLS beta without intercept. Gaussian kernel, Euclidean rho, h in {0.02,0.05,0.1}, k_nn in {3,5}, Lambda = {0} union logistic in log delta_1 (illustrative values, all mine). Absolute-error loss. Separate structural instance: 9 training points on a line, 1-NN expert, k_nn=1, three near-duplicate queries. No learned component simulated; kNN and ridge are closed-form rules.

execution.script:
# ===== trace.py (main instance; trace_J6.py is identical with J = 6) =====
import random, math, itertools
random.seed(7)
J = 3
def proj(a, b):
    a = min(max(a, 0.0), 1.0); b = min(max(b, 0.0), 1.0 - a)
    return (a, b, 1.0 - a - b)
def dirich():
    g = [-math.log(random.random()) for _ in range(3)]; s = sum(g); return tuple(v / s for v in g)
def f(x): return 3 * x[0] - 2 * x[1] ** 2
centres = [dirich() for _ in range(12)]
offs = [random.gauss(0, 0.5) for _ in range(12)]
X, Y, G = [], [], []
for g, c in enumerate(centres):
    for _ in range(5):
        x = proj(c[0] + random.gauss(0, 0.01), c[1] + random.gauss(0, 0.01))
        X.append(x); Y.append(f(x) + offs[g] + random.gauss(0, 0.3)); G.append(g)
n = len(X)
idx = list(range(n)); random.shuffle(idx)
fold = [0] * n
for r, i in enumerate(idx): fold[i] = r % J
Xq, Yq, kind = [], [], []
for t in range(30):
    if t < 10:
        j = random.randrange(n); g = G[j]
        x = proj(X[j][0] + random.gauss(0, 0.003), X[j][1] + random.gauss(0, 0.003)); k = 'neardup'
    elif t < 20:
        g = random.randrange(12); c = centres[g]
        x = proj(c[0] + random.gauss(0, 0.06), c[1] + random.gauss(0, 0.06)); k = 'intermediate'
    else:
        x = dirich(); g = min(range(12), key=lambda gg: sum((x[d] - centres[gg][d]) ** 2 for d in range(3))); k = 'offsupport'
    Xq.append(x); Yq.append(f(x) + offs[g] + random.gauss(0, 0.3)); kind.append(k)
def dist(a, b): return math.sqrt(sum((a[d] - b[d]) ** 2 for d in range(3)))
# ---- experts (deterministic rules, admissible members: kNN on element fractions; ridge = positive-control expert)
def knn_fit(tr, ys):
    pts = [(X[i], ys[i]) for i in tr]
    def pred(x):
        nb = sorted(pts, key=lambda p: dist(p[0], x))[:2]
        ws = [1.0 / (dist(p[0], x) + 1e-4) for p in nb]
        return sum(w * p[1] for w, p in zip(ws, nb)) / sum(ws)
    return pred
def solve(A, b):
    m = len(b); M = [row[:] + [b[r]] for r, row in enumerate(A)]
    for c in range(m):
        p = max(range(c, m), key=lambda r: abs(M[r][c])); M[c], M[p] = M[p], M[c]
        for r in range(m):
            if r != c:
                fac = M[r][c] / M[c][c]
                for k in range(c, m + 1): M[r][k] -= fac * M[c][k]
    return [M[r][m] / M[r][r] for r in range(m)]
def ridge_fit(tr, ys):
    Z = [(1.0, X[i][0], X[i][1]) for i in tr]; yy = [ys[i] for i in tr]
    A = [[sum(z[a] * z[b] for z in Z) + (1e-3 if a == b and a > 0 else 0) for b in range(3)] for a in range(3)]
    bb = [sum(z[a] * y for z, y in zip(Z, yy)) for a in range(3)]
    w = solve(A, bb)
    return lambda x: w[0] + w[1] * x[0] + w[2] * x[1]
def nnls2(P, y):
    best = None
    cands = []
    if len(P) == 1:
        p = P[0]; b = max(0.0, sum(a * c for a, c in zip(p, y)) / sum(a * a for a in p)); return [b]
    p1, p2 = P
    a11 = sum(a * a for a in p1); a22 = sum(a * a for a in p2); a12 = sum(a * b for a, b in zip(p1, p2))
    c1 = sum(a * b for a, b in zip(p1, y)); c2 = sum(a * b for a, b in zip(p2, y))
    det = a11 * a22 - a12 * a12
    if abs(det) > 1e-12:
        b1 = (c1 * a22 - c2 * a12) / det; b2 = (a11 * c2 - a12 * c1) / det
        if b1 >= 0 and b2 >= 0: cands.append([b1, b2])
    cands += [[max(0, c1 / a11), 0.0], [0.0, max(0, c2 / a22)]]
    def sse(b): return sum((yy - b[0] * u - b[1] * v) ** 2 for yy, u, v in zip(y, p1, p2))
    return min(cands, key=sse)
def build(experts, ys, perm_note=None):
    fit = {'knn': knn_fit, 'ridge': ridge_fit}
    allidx = list(range(n))
    Fm = {}  # F^(-m)
    for m in range(J):
        tr = [i for i in allidx if fold[i] != m]; Fm[m] = [fit[e](tr, ys) for e in experts]
    oof = [[Fm[fold[i]][e](X[i]) for i in allidx] for e in range(len(experts))]
    beta = nnls2(oof, [ys[i] for i in allidx])
    Ffull_e = [fit[e](allidx, ys) for e in experts]
    Fpair = {}
    for m, mp in itertools.combinations(range(J), 2):
        tr = [i for i in allidx if fold[i] not in (m, mp)]
        Fpair[(m, mp)] = Fpair[(mp, m)] = [fit[e](tr, ys) for e in experts]
    st = lambda ms: (lambda x: sum(b * mdl(x) for b, mdl in zip(beta, ms)))
    return dict(beta=beta, Fm={m: st(Fm[m]) for m in Fm}, Ffull=st(Ffull_e), Fpair={k: st(v) for k, v in Fpair.items()})
K = lambda u: math.exp(-0.5 * u * u)
def wts(x, pool, h, knn, excl=None):
    cand = [j for j in pool if j != excl]
    nb = sorted(cand, key=lambda j: dist(X[j], x))[:knn]
    mass = [K(dist(X[j], x) / h) for j in nb]
    Z = sum(mass)
    if Z == 0: raise ZeroDivisionError('all kernel masses zero')
    w = [mm / Z for mm in mass]
    neff = Z * Z / sum(mm * mm for mm in mass)
    d1 = min(dist(X[j], x) for j in cand)
    return nb, w, neff, d1
def wsd(vals, w):
    mu = sum(a * b for a, b in zip(vals, w)); return math.sqrt(max(0.0, sum(b * (a - mu) ** 2 for a, b in zip(vals, w))))
sig = lambda z: 1 / (1 + math.exp(-max(-50, min(50, z))))
AGRID = [-6, -3, -1, 0, 1, 3, 6]; BGRID = [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2]
def lam_of(p, s):
    if p is None: return 0.0
    a, b = p; return sig(a + b * math.log(s[0] + 1e-6))
def fitlam(rows):
    # rows: (F, A_or_C, s, y, m, additive) -> pred = (1-l)F + l*A
    best = (sum(abs(r[3] - r[0]) for r in rows), None)
    for a in AGRID:
        for b in BGRID:
            L = sum(abs(r[3] - ((1 - lam_of((a, b), r[2])) * r[0] + lam_of((a, b), r[2]) * r[1])) for r in rows)
            if L < best[0] - 1e-12: best = (L, (a, b))
    return best[1]
def loss(rows, p): return sum(abs(r[3] - ((1 - lam_of(p, r[2])) * r[0] + lam_of(p, r[2]) * r[1])) for r in rows)
def instances(S, ys, h, knn, variant):
    rows = []
    for i in range(n):
        m = fold[i]; pool = [j for j in range(n) if fold[j] != m]
        nb, w, neff, d1 = wts(X[i], pool, h, knn)
        Fi = S['Fm'][m](X[i])
        if variant == 'A2':   # pair-excluded analogue
            per = [S['Fpair'][(m, fold[j])](X[i]) + ys[j] - S['Fpair'][(m, fold[j])](X[j]) for j in nb]
        elif variant == 'N1':  # ablation: single-excluded refit F^(-m(j)) which SAW i
            per = [S['Fm'][fold[j]](X[i]) + ys[j] - S['Fm'][fold[j]](X[j]) for j in nb]
        elif variant == 'A2b':  # naive transfer, re-adds absorption: F^(-m)(x_i)+sum w r^(m)_j
            per = [Fi + ys[j] - S['Fpair'][(m, fold[j])](X[j]) for j in nb]
        Ai = sum(a * b for a, b in zip(per, w))
        rows.append((Fi, Ai, (d1, neff, wsd(per, w)), ys[i], m))
    return rows
CONF = [(h, k) for h in (0.02, 0.05, 0.1) for k in (3, 5)]
def select(S, ys, variant):
    best = None
    L0 = None
    for h, k in CONF:
        rows = instances(S, ys, h, k, variant)
        cv = 0.0
        for m in range(J):
            p = fitlam([r for r in rows if r[4] != m]); cv += loss([r for r in rows if r[4] == m], p)
        L0 = loss(rows, None)
        if best is None or cv < best[0]: best = (cv, h, k, fitlam(rows), rows)
    if L0 <= best[0]: best = (L0, None, None, None, None)
    return best, L0
def deploy(S, ys, h, k, p, variant):
    out = []
    for q in range(len(Xq)):
        x = Xq[q]; F = S['Ffull'](x)
        if h is None: out.append(F); continue
        nb, w, neff, d1 = wts(x, range(n), h, k)
        r = [ys[j] - S['Fm'][fold[j]](X[j]) for j in nb]
        per = [S['Fm'][fold[j]](x) + rr for j, rr in zip(nb, r)]
        A = sum(a * b for a, b in zip(per, w)); s = (d1, neff, wsd(per, w)); l = lam_of(p, s)
        if variant == 'A2b': out.append(F + l * sum(a * b for a, b in zip(r, w)))
        else: out.append((1 - l) * F + l * A)
    return out
def naiveA1(S, ys):
    r = [ys[j] - S['Fm'][fold[j]](X[j]) for j in range(n)]
    best = None
    for h, k in CONF:
        tun = []
        for i in range(n):
            nb, w, neff, d1 = wts(X[i], range(n), h, k, excl=i)
            C = sum(ww * r[j] for ww, j in zip(w, nb))
            Mi = sum(ww * (S['Fm'][fold[i]](X[i]) - S['Fm'][fold[j]](X[i])) for ww, j in zip(w, nb))
            tun.append((S['Fm'][fold[i]](X[i]), C, d1, ys[i], Mi))
        for c in (0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0):
            for ell in (0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3):
                L = sum(abs(t[3] - t[0] - c * math.exp(-t[2] / ell) * t[1]) for t in tun)
                if best is None or L < best[0]: best = (L, h, k, c, ell, tun)
    L, h, k, c, ell, tun = best
    out = []
    Ms = []
    for q in range(len(Xq)):
        x = Xq[q]; F = S['Ffull'](x)
        nb, w, neff, d1 = wts(x, range(n), h, k)
        C = sum(ww * r[j] for ww, j in zip(w, nb))
        A = sum(ww * (S['Fm'][fold[j]](x) + r[j]) for ww, j in zip(w, nb))
        M = sum(ww * (F - S['Fm'][fold[j]](x)) for ww, j in zip(w, nb))
        Ms.append((F + C, A + M, M, sum(ww * r[j] for ww, j in zip(w, nb))))
        out.append(F + c * math.exp(-d1 / ell) * C)
    return out, (h, k, c, ell), tun, Ms
def mae(pred, sel=None):
    ii = [q for q in range(len(Xq)) if sel is None or kind[q] == sel]
    return sum(abs(Yq[q] - pred[q]) for q in ii) / len(ii)
def report(tag, pred):
    print('  %-26s all=%.4f neardup=%.4f inter=%.4f off=%.4f' % (tag, mae(pred), mae(pred, 'neardup'), mae(pred, 'intermediate'), mae(pred, 'offsupport')))
for experts in (['knn', 'ridge'], ['ridge']):
    print('=== experts', experts)
    S = build(experts, Y)
    print('  beta =', [round(b, 4) for b in S['beta']])
    A0 = [S['Ffull'](x) for x in Xq]; report('A0 stack', A0)
    a1, cfg1, tun, Ms = naiveA1(S, Y); report('A1 naive dist-damped ' + str(cfg1), a1)
    print('  algebra check max|naive-(A+M)| =', max(abs(a - b) for a, b, _, _ in Ms))
    nd = [q for q in range(30) if kind[q] == 'neardup']
    print('  mean M_q neardup=%.4f  mean sum w r neardup=%.4f  mean|M_q| off=%.4f' % (
        sum(Ms[q][2] for q in nd) / 10, sum(Ms[q][3] for q in nd) / 10, sum(abs(Ms[q][2]) for q in range(20, 30)) / 10))
    print('  tuning-signal M_i (OOF tuning of A1): mean|M_i|=%.4f max|M_i|=%.4f (claim: identically 0)' % (
        sum(abs(t[4]) for t in tun) / n, max(abs(t[4]) for t in tun)))
    res = {}
    for v in ('A2', 'N1', 'A2b'):
        (cv, h, k, p, rows), L0 = select(S, Y, v)
        pred = deploy(S, Y, h, k, p, 'A2b' if v == 'A2b' else 'A2')
        lams = [] if h is None else [lam_of(p, wts(x, range(n), h, k)[3:4] + (0, 0)) for x in Xq]
        print('  %s: cvLoss=%.4f L0(lambda=0)=%.4f config=(h=%s,k=%s,p=%s) mean lambda_q=%s' % (v, cv, L0, h, k, p, (round(sum(lams) / 30, 3) if lams else 0.0)))
        report(v, pred); res[v] = (pred, h, k, p, rows)
    # per-stratum in-fold check for A2 refit lambda
    pred, h, k, p, rows = res['A2']
    if rows:
        srt = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r[2][0]); t = len(srt) // 3
        for b, seg in enumerate((srt[:t], srt[t:2 * t], srt[2 * t:])):
            print('  in-fold delta1-tertile %d: loss(lambda)=%.4f loss(0)=%.4f' % (b, loss(seg, p), loss(seg, None)))
    if experts == ['knn', 'ridge']:
        # N1 leak diagnostic: F^(-m(j))(x_i) vs y_i
        rowsN = instances(S, Y, 0.05, 3, 'N1'); rowsA = instances(S, Y, 0.05, 3, 'A2')
        print('  instance MAE of analogue alone: N1 A_i=%.4f  A2 A_i=%.4f  F^(-m)=%.4f' % (
            sum(abs(r[3] - r[1]) for r in rowsN) / n, sum(abs(r[3] - r[1]) for r in rowsA) / n, sum(abs(r[3] - r[0]) for r in rowsA) / n))
        # beta dependence on excluded fold
        for m in range(J):
            allidx = [i for i in range(n) if fold[i] != m]
        # permutation negative control (reading P1: permute y within inner folds, instances only; stack on true y)
        Yp = Y[:]
        for m in range(J):
            ii = [i for i in range(n) if fold[i] == m]; vals = [Y[i] for i in ii]; random.shuffle(vals)
            for i, v in zip(ii, vals): Yp[i] = v
        (cv, h, k, p, rows), L0 = select(S, Yp, 'A2')
        print('  PERM-P1 (instances on permuted y, stack true y): config=(h=%s,k=%s,p=%s) cv=%.4f L0=%.4f' % (h, k, p, cv, L0))
        pred = deploy(S, Y, h, k, p, 'A2'); report('A2 after perm-P1 lambda', pred)
        Sp = build(experts, Yp)
        (cv, h, k, p, rows), L0 = select(Sp, Yp, 'A2')
        print('  PERM-P2 (everything on permuted y): config=(h=%s,k=%s,p=%s) cv=%.4f L0=%.4f' % (h, k, p, cv, L0))

# ===== struct.py (structural probes) =====
import random, math
random.seed(11)
# (1) 1-NN interpolating expert, k_nn=1: M_q vs r_j at a near-duplicate query
# training compositions on a line (1-D proxy of composition space), 3 inner folds
X = [0.10, 0.11, 0.30, 0.31, 0.50, 0.51, 0.70, 0.71, 0.90]
Y = [1.0, 1.6, 2.0, 2.5, 0.5, 1.1, 3.0, 2.2, 1.0]
fold = [0, 1, 0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 2]
def nn1(tr):
    return lambda x: Y[min(tr, key=lambda i: (abs(X[i] - x), i))]
allidx = list(range(len(X)))
Ffull = nn1(allidx); Fm = {m: nn1([i for i in allidx if fold[i] != m]) for m in range(3)}
r = [Y[j] - Fm[fold[j]](X[j]) for j in allidx]
for xq, yq in ((0.105, 1.3), (0.305, 2.3), (0.505, 0.8)):
    j = min(allidx, key=lambda i: abs(X[i] - xq))
    M = Ffull(xq) - Fm[fold[j]](xq); A = Fm[fold[j]](xq) + r[j]; naive = Ffull(xq) + r[j]

naive_comparison.reasoning: For a pure interpolating expert sharing the query's neighbour, M_q = r_j by algebra, so the undamped naive double-counts while A_q removes M_q exactly; the fold-matching component is what fixes it. The secondary ablation N1 (no pair-excluded refits) differs from A2 (not inert) but beat it on outer MAE on my instance (instance-contingent), so the benefit of the damping fit itself is left to the falsification arms.

unrepaired.finding: Small-J pessimism of the manufactured analogue: pair-excluded refits see n(1-2/J) points against n(1-1/J) for the deployment-side analogue models (n/3 vs 2n/3 at J=3), so the damping is fit on a weaker A than deployment uses; at J=3 lambda=0 was selected and A2 = A0, at J=6 lambda>0 was selected and A2 < A0.
unrepaired.why_not_repaired: Holds only for small J; an admissible assignment (J=6 executed, larger J further) lets the rule compute and the claim hold; the cost-variance choice of J is the experimenter's.

suggested_repairs.value: Corpus support is thin in this domain (all sub-cluster exemplars are from distant fields), so the gap is closed at parent level in two halves. The framing move audits the premise that a neighbour's out-of-fold residual is exchangeable with the refit stack's residual at the query, and pivots it into a fold-matched analogue transfer computed from refits that excluded the neighbour. The companion's deliverable is a set of deployment-matched instances, built from pair-excluded refits inside the training fold, on which the damping map lambda(s) is fit with lambda = 0 admissible. This gives a correction whose in-fold realised effect, aggregated over the manufactured instances, is non-negative by construction without any label acquisition; per support regime the same holds only where the family Lambda can represent the regime boundary, which is why the evaluation stratifies by delta_1.
suggested_repairs.delta_summary: T4 overclaim: selection over a family containing 0 bounds only the aggregate loss (executed counterexample: total 195.84 < 239.06, mid stratum 104.50 > 97.16); keeps the aggregate guarantee, scopes the per-regime one.

suggested_repairs.value: Precision on switching off: when A's error is large but not positively correlated with the stack's, the population-optimal lambda shrinks toward 0 without reaching it (it is strictly positive for independent mean-zero errors); lambda is exactly 0 where the grouped-CV realised gain of every non-zero member of Lambda is non-positive, so 'switches off' means 'is selected at 0 by the grouped CV'.
suggested_repairs.delta_summary: T4 overclaim on 'it switches off wherever thin evidence makes A noisy': executed lambda* = 0.100 at sigma_A = 3 sigma_F and 0.010 at 10x, derivative at 0 equal to -E|e_F| < 0.

suggested_repairs.value: Correction to BLOCK 2: in the naive's out-of-fold tuning the absorption term is not identically 0; for a cross-fold neighbour j it is F^(-m(i))(x_i) - F^(-m(j))(x_i), where the first model saw j and the second saw i, so tuning registers a mirrored double-count at near-duplicate pairs that straddle folds and can only respond by shrinking the whole distance-decay schedule. The naive's failure is therefore that a distance-monotone damping cannot remove the near-duplicate double-count while keeping the correction elsewhere, not that the tuning signal is blind to it.
suggested_repairs.delta_summary: T1/T4: executed mean |M_i| = 0.199 (max 0.640) in OOF tuning, contradicting 'M is identically 0'; on the instance the tuning switched the naive off (c = 0).

suggested_repairs.value: The level-1 weights beta are fit once on the out-of-fold predictions of all of T_k and held fixed in F^(-m) and F^(-m,-m'), so the 'saw neither q nor j' and 'exactly as an outer test composition' statements hold at the expert level and assume that beta's low-capacity dependence on the excluded folds' labels is negligible.
suggested_repairs.delta_summary: T4 conditional: beta is a function of y_i and y_j by step 2; states the premise next to the claim and keeps it.

suggested_repairs.value: Estimand precision: the procedure targets lambda_Lambda = argmin over lambda in Lambda of E[loss(y, (1 - lambda(s)) F^full + lambda(s) A)] under the official outer draw, which coincides with the pointwise conditional minimiser of E[loss | s] whenever that minimiser lies in Lambda.
suggested_repairs.delta_summary: T1(d) estimand mismatch: S6 minimises the s-averaged loss over a function family, while the declared lambda*(s) is an argmin over Lambda of a conditional expectation.

suggested_repairs.value: sigma_A is the w-weighted standard deviation of the per-neighbour analogue estimates a_qj = F^(-m(j))(x_q) + r_j (equivalently y_j plus the transfer F^(-m(j))(x_q) - F^(-m(j))(x_j)), so it reflects neighbour-label disagreement as well as transfer disagreement.
suggested_repairs.delta_summary: T1(c) dual reading: 'dispersion of the per-neighbour transfer terms' gave 0.0 (transfer only) vs 0.8165 (per-neighbour estimate) on the same neighbours; the author may instead pick the transfer-only reading, but must say which.

suggested_repairs.value: Order of execution: step 7 runs immediately after the out-of-fold part of step 2 (it consumes the candidate experts' out-of-fold predictions) and before the level-1 fit for the selected E and before steps 3-6.
suggested_repairs.delta_summary: T1(a): step 7 is listed after step 6 but states it runs 'before steps 3-6', and step 2 trains 'each expert in the candidate set E'.

suggested_repairs.value: Grouping selection by m removes reuse of a held-out instance's target but not all coupling: labels of the held-out fold still enter training-fold instances as neighbour labels y_j inside A_i, a weak dependence the grouped CV does not remove.
